name: Bread Financial (Comenity Bank / Comenity Capital Bank store and co-brand cards)
notes: Researched from public breadfinancial.com help-center pages only (no sign-in, no EasyPay started). Each card has its own Account Center, found with the card search. Payments: online in Account Center after registering; 'EasyPay' without registering (account number plus a few details; exact fields not listed publicly, so family defaults stay); mail to the address on the back of the card or statement; phone 1-855-796-9632 (TDD/TTY 1-888-819-1918), where a fee may apply (amount not published, so no fee modelled). Registration requires account number, the primary cardholder's SSN/SIN/alternate ID and ZIP (SSN cannot be modelled; zip added). Paperless: Account menu > 'Paperless'; later via 'Manage Account' > 'Account Features'. Billing help: Customer Care number on the card/statement/bottom of Account Center pages, or a secure message to the 'Care Team'. Credit-card AutoPay is mentioned only as part of scheduling automatic payments in Account Center (help video page; steps not spelled out), so AutoPay policies stay at the family default. Online payment sources: bank accounts (inferred). Account closure steps are not published, so cancel_service stays at the family default. Review 2026-10-09: EasyPay, phone line, Register Now fields, Paperless/Account Features path and Care Team messaging re-verified on the help center. Account nav labels 'Payments', 'Payment History', 'Automatic Payments' and 'Statements' are generic (inferred); the help pages only name 'Account Center', 'Manage Account' and 'Paperless'.

help.title: How do I make payments for my credit card?
paragraphs: After you register for online access, pay in your card's Account Center, where you can make one-time payments or schedule automatic payments.
Not registered? Use EasyPay in Account Center with your account number and a few details.
You can also mail a payment to the address on the back of your card or on your statement, or pay by phone at 1-855-796-9632 (TDD/TTY 1-888-819-1918). A fee may apply to phone payments.

help.title: Pay with EasyPay
paragraphs: EasyPay lets you pay your card without registering for Account Center. Find your card's Account Center, choose EasyPay and enter your account number and a few details to make a payment.

help.title: Go paperless
paragraphs: Sign in to Account Center, open the Account menu and select Paperless.
To change the setting later, choose Manage Account from the Account menu and update it under Account Features.

help.title: Register for Account Center
paragraphs: To register you need your account number, the primary cardholder's Social Security number (or Social Insurance number or alternate ID) and the primary cardholder's ZIP or postal code. Select Register Now on your card's Account Center.

help.title: Find your card's Account Center
paragraphs: Bread Financial issues store and co-brand cards through Comenity Bank and Comenity Capital Bank, and each card has its own Account Center. Search for your card to reach its sign-in page and its Customer Care number.

help.title: Get help with payments or billing
paragraphs: Call the Customer Care number on the back of your card or on your statement; it is also at the bottom of every Account Center page. You can send a secure message to the Care Team in Account Center.

extra.intent: Using Bread Financial's help pages, find the phone number for making a credit card payment by phone. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
